a2a10JsonRpcConformance.finding: The client declared A2A 1.0 but sent legacy lower-case JSON-RPC method names.
a2a10JsonRpcConformance.correction: SendMessage, GetTask and CancelTask now match the A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding PascalCase method names.
a2a10JsonRpcConformance.protocolBoundary: A2A 1.0 only MAY deduplicate SendMessage by messageId, and the provider creates new task IDs. Standard GetTask therefore cannot recover a task when the SendMessage response is lost before the client learns its task ID. Provider sandbox request-reference lookup remains required.
